title: Project Setup & Entry Points
description: Start with project configuration and the main application layout
notes: Understand Next.js configuration, dependencies, and the root layout that wraps all pages

title: Event System & Data Models
description: Understand events, sessions, and registration data structures
notes: These files define the core domain models for events and sessions that power the platform

title: Event Display & User Interface
description: See how events are displayed to users and how they interact with event pages
notes: Follow the user journey: listing events, viewing individual event details, and starting registration

title: Registration & Checkout Flow
description: Understand how users register and pay for events
notes: Stripe integration for payment processing, promo code validation, and transaction handling

title: Database & Registration Management
description: See how registrations are stored and managed in the database
notes: Supabase integration for data persistence, registration reconciliation, and email management

title: Communication & Email System
description: Understand how event communications are sent to attendees
notes: Email templates, ledger tracking for deduplication, reminder schedules, and Resend email service integration

title: Giveaways & Lead Magnets
description: Explore the content distribution system for giveaways and lead magnets
notes: Lead magnet registry, various giveaway implementations (quizzes, tools, guides), and associated API endpoints

title: API Endpoints & Background Jobs
description: Understand the API surface for registrations, communications, and webhooks
notes: Webhook handlers for Stripe, scheduled reminders, waitlist management, and subscription endpoints
